Corollary
[Ancient scalar-curvature comparison] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0292 ↗ cor:chow-ii-ancient-trace-harnack 1. ch15:15.6\group Trace Harnack Estimates

For a complete ancient solution with bounded nonnegative curvature operator, \[ \frac{R(x_2,t_2)}{R(x_1,t_1)}\ge \exp \! \left(-\frac{d_{g(t_1)}(x_1,x_2)^2}{2(t_2-t_1)}\right) \] whenever $t_2>t_1$.
Proof

\sketch Repeat the path integration in the preceding proof using the ancient trace estimate, which has no $1/t$ term.

□
